Vendored from https://github.com/CyberAgentAILab/Web-Eye-Animation
commit 424773d1a6e1d28c1c168dbbb068ed4d0d220364 (2026-02-14), MIT licensed.

`web-eye-animation.js` is unmodified from upstream. `eyes-face.js` (in
`../../js/`) is the adapter that maps `core.py` states onto its
`window.eyes` API — see SPEC.md, "The face": "ideas port, code does not"
was written about RoboEyes, not this library, since SPEC.md says to vendor
this one directly rather than reimplement it.
